noisefloor.longDescription: Test whether an observed change may be noise, compare A/B results and examine forecast uncertainty using public, synthetic or explicitly authorized observations. NoiseFloor helps researchers check assumptions and limitations before interpreting a pattern. Results do not establish causality, investment performance or certainty about future outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Compare synthetic A/B results of 40 successes out of 100 and 55 out of 100.
Check whether this synthetic series changed: 10, 11, 9, 10, 12, 10, 9, 11, 20.
Explore an 80% forecast interval for the synthetic series 10, 11, 10, 12, 11, 13, 12, 13, 14, 13, 15.

positive.prompt: Use NoiseFloor to compare synthetic A/B results: group A has 40 successes out of 100, group B has 55 out of 100. Explain uncertainty.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the declared synthetic counts with the advertised schema and explain effect, uncertainty and test assumptions; do not claim causality from this example.

positive.prompt: Use NoiseFloor to check whether this synthetic chronological series changed: [10,11,9,10,12,10,9,11,20].
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied values without adding observations. Report change evidence and sample limitations without declaring a structural change certain.

positive.prompt: Use NoiseFloor to forecast the next value of this synthetic series with nominal coverage 0.8: [10,11,10,12,11,13,12,13,14,13,15].
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied values and nominal 0.8. Explain the returned interval, assumptions and any insufficiency rather than promising realized coverage.

positive.prompt: Use NoiseFloor to inspect whether this synthetic series could reflect sampling variation. Values: [10,11,10,12,11,13,12,13,14,20]; sample sizes: [100,110,100,120,110,130,120,130,140,200].
positive.expected_behavior: Use both aligned arrays as supplied, retain warnings and distinguish sampling evidence from a causal explanation.

positive.prompt: Use NoiseFloor to score forecasts on this synthetic chronological series: [10,11,10,12,11,13,12,13,14,13,15,14,16,15,17,16,18,17,19,18,20].
positive.expected_behavior: Use the 21 supplied observations with chronological evaluation, explain baselines and sample limitations, and do not claim future investment performance.
